2120571774270091663.en_summary: @KEDM_COM discusses Alphabet $GOOGL $80B equity raise in June ($15B convertible preferred, $25B common, $40B ATM) to fund AI Capex and taxes ahead of SpaceX $SPCX, OpenAI, Anthropic IPOs. Anthropic IPO up to $64.4B trading as $ANT on Nov 19. Typical IPOs underperform ~20% on 3-year, more for unprofitable. $SPCX not for patient investors; index providers waived profitability, passive forced to buy after pump before unlock. SpaceX figured out dumping on retail at scale.
2120571774270091663.zh_summary: @KEDM_COM 討論 Alphabet $GOOGL 在 6 月 800 億美元股權融資（150 億可轉換優先股、250 億普通股、400 億 ATM）以資助 AI 資本支出和稅務，趕在 SpaceX $SPCX、OpenAI、Anthropic IPO 之前。Anthropic IPO 可達 644 億美元，11 月 19 日以 $ANT 交易。典型 IPO 3 年期跑輸約 20%，未盈利公司更多。$SPCX 不適合耐心投資者；指數提供商放棄盈利要求，被動投資者被迫在泵後解鎖前買入。SpaceX 學會大規模向零售傾銷。

ticker_notes.SPCX: IPO 後跑輸，指數強迫買入，不適合長期持有
ticker_notes.ANT: 即將 IPO，歷史 IPO 跑輸
